title: Tech Note: Accessing COM Objects within 4D

historical_commentary.text: This note shows how the new LAUNCH EXTERNAL PROCESS command in 4D 2004 could be used to access Windows COM objects, aided by a CreateObject macro (part of the 4D Macro Pack) with an object browser for exploring a COM object's properties. COM is a Windows-only legacy technology whose relevance has declined industry-wide in favor of .NET, web services, and REST APIs, and this specific integration technique is now a historical curiosity rather than a practical approach for cross-platform 4D applications.
related_updates: COM automation has been largely superseded industry-wide by .NET, web services, and REST/JSON APIs for Windows interop
Modern 4D applications needing to talk to external Windows or web services typically use HTTP Client commands or REST APIs rather than COM automation
4D's 4D Macro Pack and macro-based code generation tooling has itself evolved considerably since 2004
